question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched position as General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, with no scheduled leadership transition before the 21st Party Congress in late 2027, underpins trader consensus that he will remain in power through the end of 2026. At age 73, he continues to direct diplomacy, policy, elite appointments, and military modernization without a designated successor or visible factional challenges, consistent with his consolidation of authority across party, state, and PLA institutions. Recent reporting highlights ongoing public engagements and preparations for a potential fourth term, leaving little scope for removal in the narrow remaining window. While abrupt health developments, elite realignments, or unforeseen crises could theoretically alter this trajectory, current evidence points to structural continuity through the resolution date.
